text:
alex: kicking off staged rollout v2.14 -> hosted-canary 3% now. change window 14:00-16:00 PT. tagging SRE/QA for quick signal checks :eyes:
deploy-bot: rollout started: staged_pct=3, model=v2.14, targets=canary-hosted, roll_id=roll-6567893210
deploy-bot: healthcheck summary (t+1m): errors=0, p99_latency=82ms, success_rate=99.98%
mei: seeing a small uptick in 5xxs for eu-west behind the 3% shard, looks like auth proxy 502s. pulling logs now.
mei: logs snippet: `upstream_connect_error, timeout connecting to auth-svc` — not seeing model errors yet.
sanjay: thanks @mei. can you confirm whether 502s are for existing baseline traffic or only on canary? :point_up:
mei: it's concentrated on canary nodes (eu-canary pool), baseline unchanged. correlating with routing shift timestamp.
lina: ops, are there any recent infra changes in eu-west? storage or proxy deploys?
carla-ops: no infra deploys in the window. we did a config tweak to envoy earlier but that was 3h ago. investigating.
alex: suggestion: hold at 3% until we confirm cause. not comfortable progressing with region-specific 5xxs. calling for a quick vote: go/no-go to continue ramp.
sanjay: vote: NO-GO. recommend pinback to v2.13 for canary and rollback incremental targets while we root-cause.
lina: +1 no-go. need root-cause before 10pct.
mei: i'm +1 stop — rolling logs into a short dump and will post traces in case we need rollback thread.
deploy-bot: initiating hold on rollout roll-6567893210. staged_pct frozen at 3. No further shifts queued.
alex: deploy-bot, can you start a canary rollback to previous pinned model v2.13 for the affected canary nodes only (eu-west)? we want minimal blast radius.
deploy-bot: executing targetted rollback: roll_target=eu-canary, from=v2.14 -> to=v2.13, action=rollback-started, rollback_id=rb-6567893210-1
mei: observing rollback traffic divert now. 5xx rate dropping within 30s.
sanjay: confirm pin: system should pin v2.13 for canary until we clear the incident. alex please confirm pin duration.
alex: pin v2.13 on canary for 4 hours, postmortem to follow. we'll replay tests against v2.14 in staging and re-run proxy tests.
lina: i'll prepare release notes update and call out the rollback in the changelog snippet.
carla-ops: I'll run a targeted probe suite across eu-canary and eu-baseline and post results once green.
mei: adding trace: trace_id=abc123, shows auth proxy timeout sequence starting right at the traffic handoff. filing issue #INC-2021.
alex: thanks everyone. action items: 1) carla run probes, 2) mei continue traces, 3) sanjay coordinate rollback pinning and monitor, 4) lina update release notes. reconvene once probes are green.
sanjay: noted. schedule a short status at +20m.
deploy-bot: rollback completed: rollback_id=rb-6567893210-1, status=success, effected_targets=eu-canary, final_staged_pct=0 for v2.14 on eu-canary
alex: closing thread for now, follow-ups in INC-2021 and a postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
